# The paths a pull request may change only with the orchestrator's word on its head: a commit
# status orchestrator/word on that exact sha (#3917 A3). One Python regex a line, matched against
# each changed file's path from its start. .github/scripts/merge-train.py reads this file from
# main's tree, never from a pull request's, and it's under .github/, so a change to it needs the
# word too. core/ and engine/ aren't here: they're never a train's.
^\.github/
^AGENTS\.md$
^CONTRIBUTING\.md$
^docs/decisions\.md$
^tools/
^app/build\.sh$
^app/setup\.sh$
^app/check\.sh$
# A run's file is shared once a second run sources it, so all of check/ is gated.
^app/check/
^app/patches/gpui-.*\.patch$
^app/platform/
host\.h$
# Agent code: the agents' tools, their permission rules and what they may reach.
^app/src/agent
